card.name: Linking words in antiplatelet drug text
card.fires_on: Commas, 'and', 'of', 'the' and closing brackets that come right after antiplatelet drug names (clopidogrel, prasugrel) or acid-reducer names (PPIs, H2 blockers). It also fires on small words before dose terms in antiplatelet or platelet-therapy text.

modes.label: After antiplatelet names
modes.description: Comma or 'and' right after clopidogrel or prasugrel in a list or comparison.
modes.example: Warfarin, heparin, enoxaparin, clopidogrel, prasugrel<<,>> rivaroxaban, apixaban

modes.label: Acid reducers with clopidogrel
modes.description: Small linking word in advice about PPIs or H2 blockers used with clopidogrel.
modes.example: consider short-acting antacid in place of proton pump inhibitors (PPIs)<< and>> H 2 -receptor antagonists

modes.label: Before dose or therapy terms
modes.description: 'the' or 'of' before 'maintenance dose' or 'alternative anti-platelet therapy'.

card.plain: It fires on small linking words and commas right after names of clopidogrel-type blood thinners.
